r2_basis: R2d, option 1 of the R2c record, requested on 2026-11-18 for issue #452: R2c with its one-step mean extended to the alternator side's position. R2c averaged the three corner surfaces over the position of the plane y = -5 shared by the alternator's rear face and the fan cylinder's end; the line where the alternator side meets the plane of the plenum top stayed fixed, and the surface twisted about it. corner_line_blend_mm averages that mean again over the alternator side moved within +-12 mm, so the line moves with it; it needs corner_line_blend_mm = three_surface_corner_blend_mm. Where the alternator side meets the shared plane the result is the mean of two 12 mm blends, with the same apex radius and a 4 mm setback instead of 3. Within the owner's decisions: 12 mm throughout as an unmeasured layout hypothesis chosen for numerical admissibility, open to the owner's veto; the alternator's rear plane not moved; the voxel and the audit rule unchanged. Every other value is that of study.json. The joins are unmeasured layout hypotheses, and the r = 70 mm alternator envelope is not the 240 A alternator selected in #454.
